headline: EDC (98/98) and millbrook-hollow (2/2) now carry five-input+ ruler pins. millbrook measures PASS clean 1.0 on both units (demo, as expected). EDC measured on 5 representative units — all FAIL the 0.6 gate (honest; 0.0000–0.3333). No unit was left unpinned-and-quotable.
note_on_field_count: phase_r3 started at five inputs (fixture/entities/id_map/domain_manifest/documents). rounds 3–4 added editions_registry and sample. Pins here freeze all seven.

edc.baseline_scope: 5 units judged live then frozen as fixtures and re-measured offline under the pin. Full 98-unit aggregate was not judged (≈1418 docs); unmeasured units stay pinned and are quotable only after a live/fixture score against their pin.

baseline_summary.verdict: FAIL on every measured unit — the coverage gap is real, not a measurement artifact

special_case_las_vegas_2026.id_map: absent on disk (resolve never wrote the unit). Pin carries explicit null; compare_ruler_pin treats null==null as agreed absence (not incomplete).

main.note: demo domain — base model knows none of it; extraction coverage is floor-perfect on authored graph

deviations: EDC full-domain live judge (1418 docs) was not run; 5-unit sample is the measured baseline. Unmeasured pinned units are not silently given a number.
compare_ruler_pin now treats explicit null==null (agreed absence) as verified; a missing pin key remains fail-closed. Needed for las_vegas/2026 which has no resolve id_map file.
